title: Muscle Strength and Functional Autonomy of Elderly Women
brief_summary: This study shows an evaluation of the correlation between the muscle strength levels and functional autonomy of elderly women.
study_population: The population consists of 123 elderly women residents of São Lucas shelter, located in Cacimba Velha, Teresina-PI, Brazil. The sample consists of 35 elderly women. The elderly participants in the study signed a written informed consent.
